verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide documents first-class WebAuthn and passkeys: WebAuthn in the default browser flow, WebAuthn as two-factor, LoginLess WebAuthn, and passkeys with Conditional UI/autofill and Modal UI. The pack has no evidence of magic-link or email OTP sign-in, which is half of what the story asks for. Missing for 10: magic-link login, email OTP as a passwordless method, independent or hands-on corroboration of the passkey flows.
